question: Should OpenClaw keep supporting or backport the legacy `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or treat it as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through Skill Workshop?
rationale: Automation can verify the release parser behavior and the linked fix shape, but current main removed the helper and current instructions point users to Skill Workshop, so resolving this requires a maintainer support-boundary decision.

options.title: Close obsolete helper path
options.body: Confirm Skill Workshop is the intended replacement, then close the linked PR and this issue as no longer planned for core.

options.title: Refresh or backport helper repair
options.body: Keep the released helper supported by refreshing or backporting the parser normalization and focused tests without reintroducing obsolete workflow guidance.

recommendation.title: Close obsolete helper path
recommendation.body: Confirm Skill Workshop is the intended replacement, then close the linked PR and this issue as no longer planned for core.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal for both the original bundled skill surface and the current support-boundary decision.
